_comment: A 2026-regulation Formula car, order-of-magnitude. Public figures only; no team data. Mass is the 768 kg minimum plus a part-race fuel load. Power is the combined 400 kW combustion and ~350 kW electric deployment, treated as always available - see Scope in the README, because the real energy budget is finite. v_max is set high on purpose so that top speed is set by drag, not by a gearing cap: a binding cap would make added drag free and destroy the downforce trade-off.
name: 2026-spec formula car
